reviews.text: best vet clinic!! my elderly cat King, who is a pretty healthy kitty for his age (almost 17) has been going to this clinic for few years...they keep us both  on track with his care without over doing anything.

Brandie and Talor are the absolute best vet team ever!

The level of care provided is impeccable- they do what’s best for your pet while also fitting your needs, they never overcharge and are super cost conscientious, they are extremely smart and thoroughly explain everything, they never rush you and spend ample time with each patient.

We love Advocate Vet Services!! Thank you for all you do!

All the reviews here are absolutely true! Dr. Cox & Taylor are the best! You can tell they really care about the animals and owners. I always knew my pups were getting the best care. And if we ever needed something they were always very quick to respond to calls and texts. Can't recommend them enough!
Amazing Vet!! We completely trust Dr. Brandie Cox. She and Talor are so kind and knowledgeable. We feel blessed to have them. I wish I could give more than 5 stars!
Absolutely 💯 wonderful experience. They have immensely solved my babies issues. Wish they treated people!! I would be first in line!!🤭😻 …
